issue.title: Record the decision that Bob Refs is a thin client and opening a reference never mutates the vault
issue.description: Proposed by phases bob-cli-5s.1-.9 of epic bob-cli-5s; recorded by bob-cli-5s.land.

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Add an accepted decisions record, for example `decisions/refs-panel-is-a-thin-client.md`: "Bob Refs is a thin client and opening a reference never mutates the vault". Proposed by every phase of epic bob-cli-5s (bob-cli-5s.1 note #2, .2 #1, .3 #2, .4 #1, .5 #1, .6 #1, .7 #1, .8 #1, .9 #1) because the epic's auto decision `refs_decision_memory = no` (planner default, no human review) skipped it. Recorded by bob-cli-5s.land. Bryan should confirm he wants the record; closing still needs his permission plus `sase memory init`.

Claim: the Bob Refs panel in Bob Mac Capture extends `decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client`. bob owns every reference fact (which references exist, kind, status, Blocked, dates, annotations, Today). The app only filters, ranks, sections, and presents what `bob ref list`, `bob ref show -c`, and `bob plan` return, plus PDF intrinsics read with PDFKit (pages, outline, thumbnail, excerpts), which are file facts. It never parses frontmatter, note bodies, or `reading_state_source`, and never writes the vault. Opening a reference (Highlights, default app, Obsidian, Finder) is a retrieval, not a status gesture: it never changes reading state, task lanes, review state, or any vault file (`decisions:task-lanes-are-sticky`). Open history lives only in the app's Application Support directory.

Evidence: plan `plan:202610/bob_refs_panel.md` ("Ground rules": Thin client, Opening never mutates; decision `refs_decision_memory`); research `research:202610/highlights_quick_open_refs_panel/highlights_quick_open_refs_panel.md`; bob-mac-capture commits e3f918d..2016864 (RefsCore, RefsLibrary, RefsPanelModel open dispatch through NSWorkspace only). Link [[mac-capture-is-a-thin-client]] and [[task-lanes-are-sticky]]. Related but distinct: bob-cli-51 (bob ref library verbs are read-only).

issue.creation_reason: Every bob-cli-5s phase proposed this decisions record after the epic's unreviewed auto decision refs_decision_memory=no skipped it; the land agent files it so Bryan can accept or cancel it.

payload.entry: Phase bob-cli-5x.4 bookkeeping: if the "Bob Refs is a thin client" record is accepted, its claim must say the app never writes the vault itself, and that ⌘S is an explicit user gesture asking bob to run its own writer (bob ref scan -w, the same scan the 15-minute cron runs) — the app only presents the JSON report bob returns.
